## Ingredients

Really you just wing it and throw things together. But here is a template that you can build off of: 

- 2 cans of beans
- 4 roma tomatoes 
- 2 bell peppers (red and yellow)
- cilantro/parsley
- 1 bag frozen corn
- 1 red onion
- 1 jalapeno

For the sauce again you can wing it (I've seen folks use salsa as a sauce even). But here is a simple base that you could add hot sauce to: 

- ⅓ cup olive oil
- 4 tablespoons lime juice (can split with some red wine vinegar if desired)
- 1 teaspoon granulated sugar
- ½ teaspoon salt
- ½ teaspoon black pepper
- ¼ teaspoon garlic powder

## Instructions

Mix and serve with chips
